text: Sample definitions: Pantheon+ has 1701 entries with 203 DES Y3 SN; DES5Y has 1829 SN, 1635 DES SN (0.0596 < z < 1.12) and 194 at z < 0.1; the cuts 0.02 <= z_HD <= 1.2 and (DES5Y) delta m > 1 leave 1417 Pantheon+ entries and 1754 DES5Y SN.
rests_on: Every fit and chi2 in the paper is on these samples; a different selection would move all of C2-C4 and C7
